Enables "physical coordinate lock" for the blocking rectangle.\nThis service does not read screen content or listen to any events. It is used only to keep the blocking overlay fixed at its physical position under system-level transforms such as Xiaomi One-handed mode.
Keep the blocking rectangle fixed to physical screen coordinates

By default, Xiaomi One-handed mode moves the blocking overlay downward. After enabling this app's accessibility service, the overlay remains fixed to physical screen coordinates and is unaffected by One-handed mode.\n\nThis service does not read screen content or listen to any events. It only obtains the system's "trusted overlay" capability for the window.
Lock blocked area to physical coordinates

When enabled, the blocked area stays at its physical screen position in Xiaomi One-handed mode (with inverse compensation). When disabled, it moves with One-handed mode and automatically yields. Recommended: keep this enabled.
